findings.evidence: Pre-PR text (diff line removed): "The estimates are the contraction case of Engel--Nagel ... Theorem II.3.5" -- the author's own prior wording identifies II.3.5 as the contraction case, yet the PR generalizes the statement to `HasGrowthBound omega M` and leaves the same locator. Sibling files cite the correct section for this material: Resolvent/Deriv.lean:56 and Resolvent/Identity.lean:21-22 both name "Theorem II.1.10" for the Laplace-transform resolvent, and the repo cites precisely elsewhere (Generator/Uniqueness.lean:49 "Theorem II.1.4", Dissipative/Hilbert.lean:30-31 "Example II.3.24 and Proposition II.3.23").
findings.fix: Cite the actual sources in the References block: Engel--Nagel Theorem II.1.10 / Corollary II.1.11 for the power formula and the iterated bound, keeping II.3.5-3.8 only as the generation theorems these feed (the roadmap likewise lists "Engel-Nagel II.3.5-3.8" under the Hille--Yosida generation milestone, not under the resolvent power bounds).
findings.issue: The diff deletes the qualifier "The estimates are the contraction case of" but keeps "Theorem II.3.5" as the sole reference, so the file now attributes both the general `(M, omega)` bound (`resolvent_pow_norm_le`) and the newly added power/integral formula (`resolvent_pow_succ_apply`) to the contraction-case generation theorem. Neither result is II.3.5: the `R(lambda)^n x = 1/(n-1)! int t^(n-1) e^(-lambda t) S(t)x dt` formula with `norm (R(lambda)^n) <= M/(lambda-omega)^n` is Corollary II.1.11, the corollary of the Laplace-transform Theorem II.1.10 that this repo already cites for exactly this material, and the general-`(M, omega)` generation theorem is II.3.8.

summary: Sources are named and there is no laundering, but the References block still points only at Engel--Nagel Theorem II.3.5 after the file generalized past the contraction case and added the integral power formula, so neither new main result is credited to its actual location in the cited book.
